findings.value: A weekly Sunday produce market in Victoria Park, E2, run by the Good Market Company and set up in 2017 as a summer project.

evidence.quote: A weekly Sunday produce market inside East London's most beautiful park
The market is run by the Good Market Company
Established back in June 2017 and initially launched as a six month summer project

notes: The market's own site describes it as a weekly Sunday produce market; Secret London (11 July 2023) gives its history. Time Out's review is dated 11 May 2018, too old to back crowd, music or status; it mentions live jazz sometimes, which cannot be used. No closing or new-owner news found. The site's own page does not give a date.
